options.name: Steam / Netflix

options.name: Overwatch Menu

layout_switcher_mechanism.toggle_ui_location: TopBar right quick controls & Settings modal

layout_1_steam_netflix.name: Steam / Netflix Row Matrix
layout_1_steam_netflix.structure: Header -> Hero Spotlight Banner -> Horizon Category Tabs (sticky) -> Stacked Horizontal Category Rows -> Dedicated Full-Width 'Soutien' Banner Row -> Footer

focus_navigation_model.D_pad_up_down: Navigates between sections: Top Bar -> Hero Action Buttons -> Category Tabs -> Row 1 -> Row 2 -> Soutien Banner
focus_navigation_model.D_pad_left_right: Scrolls items horizontally within the active category row or switches tabs
focus_navigation_model.Enter_Key: Opens Detail modal/view or launches creation
focus_navigation_model.Back_Escape: Scrolls focus back to Top Bar or closes dialogs
focus_navigation_model.Focus_Visual: ring-2 ring-[var(--brand)] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#0A0C10] scale-[1.04] shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(255,42,85,0.4)] z-20

sections.hero_spotlight: Full-bleed background with dark gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0C10] via-black/40 to-transparent), large title with kanji background watermark (e.g., 創), synopsis, tags, 'Lancer' primary CTA button, and 'Favori' button.
sections.category_rows: Each category (e.g. Films, Livres, Séries, Favoris) gets an independent horizontal scroll section with snapping (`snap-x snap-mandatory`), arrow nav hints on hover, poster aspect ratio 2:3.
sections.soutien_section: Distinct glowing card full width (`bg-gradient-to-r from-red-950/40 via-purple-950/20 to-slate-900 border border-red-500/30 p-8 rounded-xl`) with membership perks and support CTAs.

layout_1_steam_netflix.mobile_adaptation: Vertical stacked rows with touch-swipe carousel for cards; sticky category pill bar at top for jump-scrolling.

layout_2_overwatch_menu.name: Overwatch Vertical Spine
layout_2_overwatch_menu.structure: Split screen layout (Desktop): Left 280px Vertical Category Spine + Soutien Quick Access -> Right dynamic Stage featuring 'Création du Moment' + 4-column Compact Grid of selected category works.

focus_navigation_model.D_pad_up_down: Moves selection up/down the left vertical spine items (Toutes, Livres, Films, Séries, Favoris, Soutien)
focus_navigation_model.D_pad_left_right: Right arrow moves focus from vertical spine into the right content stage grid; Left arrow returns focus to the spine
focus_navigation_model.Enter_Key: Activates category or launches focused card
focus_navigation_model.Focus_Visual: Spine items: glowing left accent bar + text slide right (`translate-x-2 text-white bg-white/10`). Grid cards: bold brand border + outline glow.

sections.vertical_spine: Left bar with Japanese vertical text or stylized kanji badge, large category titles with counters. Soutien pinned at bottom with special crimson badge.
sections.stage_hero: Occupies top of right pane: wide 21:9 banner with cinematic backdrop, admin spotlight badge, action triggers.
sections.category_cluster: Dense 4-column card matrix directly below hero, auto-updated based on active spine item.

layout_2_overwatch_menu.mobile_adaptation: Collapsible left drawer spine triggered by hamburger; main view displays top hero + compact 2-column grid.

layout_3_valorant_showcase.name: Valorant Stage Showcase
layout_3_valorant_showcase.structure: Full-screen cinematic stage mode. Top minimal category filter bar -> Massive backdrop stage of currently focused work (Big art, bold title, Japanese calligraphy overlay, full details) -> Bottom floating thumbnail strip carousel -> Separate Full-Screen Soutien Drawer/Slide-over.

focus_navigation_model.D_pad_left_right: Moves through bottom thumbnail strip, dynamically updating background image, title, and synopsis in real-time
focus_navigation_model.D_pad_up_down: Up moves focus to action buttons ('Lancer', 'Bande-annonce', 'Favori') or top category bar; Down returns to thumbnail strip
focus_navigation_model.Focus_Visual: Thumbnail strip: active item gains red corner brackets, elevated scale `scale-110`, ambient glow.

sections.backdrop_stage: Immersive fixed backdrop with smooth crossfade transition on focus change, large typography (`text-5xl lg:text-7xl font-black`), kanji motif watermark behind title.
sections.thumbnail_strip: Floating glass bottom bar (`backdrop-blur-md bg-black/60 border-t border-white/10 p-4`), horizontal scroll with keyboard arrow highlights.
sections.soutien_panel: Dedicated full-screen modal or dedicated tab in switcher with interactive tiers, creator note, and support links.

layout_3_valorant_showcase.mobile_adaptation: Vertical gesture card stack with quick bottom action bar and touch-slide preview.

supported_inputs: Gamepad D-Pad + A/B buttons + Bumpers (LB/RB for category switching)
controller_dpad_accessibility.on_screen_dpad_mobile: Floating translucent virtual D-Pad (toggleable in settings) for mobile touch users to experience console-feel navigation
controller_dpad_accessibility.keyboard_shortcut_legend: Visible bottom status bar displaying: [←/→] Naviguer | [↑/↓] Catégories | [Enter] Lancer | [F] Favori | [Tab] Changer Layout
focus_management_rules: Always maintain visible focus ring on focused item
Auto-scroll container to keep focused element in viewport center
Ensure data-testid attributes are set on all focusable cards, buttons, and layout toggles

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a stateful layout switcher in App.js / Home.js that seamlessly renders one of the 3 specified layout components (SteamNetflixLayout, OverwatchSpineLayout, ValorantStageLayout).
Implement uniform keyboard arrow & gamepad D-pad navigation state across all 3 layouts so controller support works flawlessly in tests and usage.
Maintain all existing API calls, admin features (setting creation du moment, editing, deleting), authentication state, theme variables, and sound effects.
Ensure every layout includes clear visual separation for the 'Création du moment' and the 'Soutien' section.
All interactive elements must carry proper data-testid attributes for automated testing.
